$comment: Machine-readable inventory of the Wave-F verification surface. Facts only: what exists, where it lives, what it proves. Owned by lane F10 (docs/inventory/f10-verification.json). Every number here was measured in this clone, not copied from a brief. Rescue after round 2: per-item deterministic paths are held by an atomic sibling lock across the complete fixture lifetime, PNG creation is O_EXCL, Job A and Wave-F execute disjoint projects, the Stably action inputs are structurally pinned, and a successful Wave-F upload reconciles every executed item to deterministic PNG + video + trace + end-of-test screenshot retention.

tiers.note: A green run here proves front-end behaviour against a fixture the suite itself authored. Never cite it as server evidence.

laneSpecDirectoryConvention.ownership: policy amendment #2 — each lane creates and owns its own directory; F10 owns e2e/wave-f/harness/** and the shared files directly under e2e/wave-f/
laneSpecDirectoryConvention.laneIdDerivation: first path segment under e2e/wave-f/; a spec directly under e2e/wave-f/ is attributed to the lane id 'wave-f'

screenshots.perItemDirectorySegmentReason: two items in one spec file that pass the same shot name must not share a path; <NN> resets per item, so without this they did
screenshots.nameUniquenessRule: names must be unique within an item; evidence.shot() rejects a reused name rather than overwriting
screenshots.concurrentInvocationRule: a sibling <testId>.lock directory is claimed with atomic mkdir for the complete fixture lifetime; a second Playwright process running the same item fails before it can clear or write the deterministic directory
screenshots.atomicFileCreation: page.screenshot() returns bytes first, then the final PNG is created with flag wx (O_EXCL); no exists-check/write TOCTOU and no overwrite
screenshots.staleArtifactHandling: each item's own directory is emptied at fixture setup; a directory this run did not touch keeps its old run.json and is visibly stale

perTestScreenshot.note: written by screenshot:"on" for a passing item; test-failed-1.png for a failing one

scanBeforeUpload.gates: the wave-F artifact upload runs only when this step's outcome is success
scanBeforeUpload.successfulSuiteRetentionGate: the reporter's executed-item count is reconciled to run.json manifests, deterministic PNGs, video.webm, trace.zip and test-finished-N.png; any missing or empty class fails closed
scanBeforeUpload.limit: finds only representations of secrets present in the job's own environment

settingsTabs.keyboardModel: roving tabindex — Tab reaches the selected trigger only; the rest are reached with ArrowDown/ArrowUp

smokeSpec.durableEffect: PUT /dag-workflows/<id> returns outcome "created" from the real store, and the record is still listed after a browser reload

itemInventory.keying: path relative to e2e/, POSIX separators
itemInventory.thinNote: the 3 evidence-contract items test the evidence fixture itself, not a product surface, so they are labelled thin and do not raise the substantive floor

ports.neverReason: the owner's own instance is live on 18000; binding it destroys their session and points every mocked spec at the wrong server

ciLegs.proves: remote execution of this repository's suite on a GitHub-hosted ubuntu runner
ciLegs.collects: 253 tests = 218 substantive + 35 thin (the mocked tier only)
ciLegs.projectFilterReason: this is the floor job; a bare run collected both projects, so every Wave-F item from all five lanes ran inside it and one flaky unmocked spec could turn the floor result red
ciLegs.fullInventoryAssertedBy: the `Assert the full E2E inventory` step in the same job: an unfiltered --list collection (no browser, no preview) that still throws on inventory drift

ciLegs.consumesRepositorySpecsReason: no input accepts a repository path, glob or config file; project-id/test-suite-id select Stably-platform work, not this checkout's e2e/*.spec.ts
ciLegs.secretsConfiguredOnForkNote: STABLY_API_KEY and STABLY_PROJECT_ID are set on ahuserious/k-dense-byok (names only, both stamped 2026-08-19T03:08:25Z). An earlier F10 report said they were unset; that was wrong.
ciLegs.triggerReason: with the credential gate satisfied the action step is no longer skipped, so a push trigger would spend a paid Stably run per integration push on a job this lane has proven cannot be evidence for this suite

ciLegs.proves: remote execution of the unmocked Wave-F tier plus the Gate U evidence bundle
ciLegs.phaseBudgetCheck: node e2e/check-job-timeout-budget.mjs --target wave-f, first step of the job
ciLegs.evidenceScanGate: node e2e/wave-f/evidence-scan.mjs; the upload is gated on its outcome and a successful suite must reconcile every retained artifact class

honestClaim.remoteExecutionEvidence: GitHub-hosted runner, ubuntu-24.04, fingerprinted per run
honestClaim.stablyCloudBrowsersReason: the Stably runner action's contract selects Stably-platform tests and accepts no repository spec path; no run has ever executed this checkout's suite on a Stably-hosted browser
